summary: Full E2E validation of new Captain Scoring feature (backend + frontend @ 390px mobile). Backend pytest test_captain_scoring.py 13/13 PASS. Frontend flows all PASS: (1) /score renders 8 team buttons + PIN input + Start Scoring; footer 'Captain Scoring' link present on all pages. (2) Wrong PIN 9999 → captain-login-error 'Invalid team or PIN' (backend returned 401). (3) Correct PIN 4321 for Team Martin → captain-status-notice 'Scoring opens when the round begins...View Leaderboard' shown (status was not-started). (4) sessionStorage persists across page.reload — still signed in after refresh; captain-signout returns to login screen. (5) PIN 4321 NOT in page source; /api/public/teams returns 8 teams with NO pin/password field. (6) Admin login OK → /admin/scoring → Captain Scoring PINs section shows 'PIN set' + 'Reset PIN' for Team Martin. Set 8888 for Team White via pin-input-white/pin-save-white → pin-flash 'PIN saved for Team White — share it privately with the captain' displayed. 2-digit PIN keeps pin-save-white disabled=True. (7) Set scoring=live via PUT /api/admin/scoring (200). Captain martin signs in → captain-hole-current='Hole 1' (matches startingHole=1). Enter 4 → save → flash 'Saved — Hole 1: 4' + auto-advance to Hole 2. Enter 3 → save → flash 'Saved — Hole 2: 3'. Prev twice back to Hole 1 → captain-score-existing 'Existing score on this hole: 4. Saving will overwrite it.' Enter 5, save button label='Save' → click → label flips to 'Overwrite' (armed) → click again → flash 'Saved — Hole 1: 5'. captain-card-1 shows '5', captain-card-2 shows '3'. Header progress='2/18 holes'. (8) Public /leaderboard live: scorecard-toggle-martin expanded → hole-martin-1=5, hole-martin-2=3 (captain-entered values propagate correctly). (9) No team-switch UI in scorecard (no 'Change team'/'Switch team' text, no captain-team-* buttons rendered post-login). (10) Set scoring=final → captain page shows captain-status-notice 'The round is complete — See the final standings on the public leaderboard. View Leaderboard'; no captain-score-input rendered. (11) Danger Zone reset-scores-button → reset-scores-confirm → verified final DB state: status=not-started, scores=[]. (12) Regression: /, /leaderboard, /teams, /schedule, /champions, /rules all load with zero page errors. FINAL DB STATE VERIFIED: {status:'not-started', scores:[]}. Team White has test PIN 8888 set (harmless per main-agent note); Team Martin retains its PIN. Team names/rosters/holes untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: Security good: /api/public/teams response contains no pin/password fields; PIN never appears in /score page source; login page has no prefilled credentials.
PIN write-only pattern working: admin section shows 'PIN set' status only, never the digits; reset flow verified.
Overwrite arm flow works exactly as spec — button label transitions Save→Overwrite on first press when a differing score exists; second press commits.
sessionStorage session correctly scoped per-tab and per-team; status changes (live→final) update UI on next page load.
